scripts.build:android:preview: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview --non-interactive
scripts.build:android:production: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.build:ios:preview: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview --non-interactive
scripts.build:ios:preview:interactive: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.build:ios:simulator: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview-simulator --non-interactive
scripts.build:ios:production: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.build:ios:production:interactive: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 EAS_BUILD_NO_EXPO_GO_WARNING=true npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.submit:android:production: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli submit --platform android --profile production --latest --non-interactive
scripts.submit:android:production:by-build-id: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli submit --platform android --profile production --non-interactive --id
scripts.build:android:huawei: npm run verify:huawei && npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile huawei --non-interactive
scripts.build:android:huawei:apk: npm run verify:huawei && npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile huawei-apk --non-interactive
scripts.build:android:huawei:local: npm run verify:huawei && npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile huawei-local --non-interactive
scripts.release:android:play: npm run verify:google-play && npm run build:android:production && npm run submit:android:production
scripts.submit:ios:production: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli submit --platform ios --profile production --latest
scripts.submit:ios:production:by-build-id: cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 npx eas-cli submit --platform ios --profile production --id
